title: Fix frontend build and add advanced analytics UI on Dashboard

requirements.summary: Diagnose and fix the frontend-side causes of the current build/deploy failure so the app compiles and loads without runtime errors.
acceptanceCriteria: A clean build completes without errors for both backend and frontend.
A deploy completes successfully and the app loads without runtime errors.
Any fixes are captured in code (no manual post-build steps required).

file_operations.description: Resolve any build/runtime issues originating from app bootstrapping (provider composition, router mounting, QueryClient setup), ensuring the frontend compiles and loads cleanly.
Fix any routing/type issues that prevent compilation (TanStack Router route tree typing/registration, imports/exports), ensuring no build-time errors.
Fix any actor/identity initialization or dependency issues that can trigger build-time type errors or runtime crashes during deploy; ensure hooks remain compatible with current backend typings.
Correct any React Query typing/import issues that prevent compilation (query keys, enabled flags, return types), and ensure hooks are consistent with the generated backend type surface.

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks and Dashboard sections to display top-selling products, most-searched products, and net profit by period with selectable presets and loading/empty states.
acceptanceCriteria: React Query hooks are added in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for each new backend analytics method.
Dashboard page (frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx) renders sections/cards for: top-selling products, most-searched products, and net profit by period.
Dashboard supports selecting a time range/period grouping (at minimum: a few preset ranges such as last 7 days / last 30 days / this month) and updates analytics accordingly.
All new user-visible UI strings use the existing i18n helper (t(...)) and do not introduce hard-coded English/Spanish strings in components.

file_operations.description: Add React Query hooks for advanced analytics using existing actor access: useTopItemsSold (wraps getTopItemsSold), useTopSearchedProducts (wraps getTopSearchedProducts), and useNetProfitByInterval (wraps aggregateNetProfitByInterval). Ensure query keys include the selected limit/range/interval inputs so Dashboard selection changes trigger refetch.

Render new Dashboard sections/cards for advanced analytics (top-selling products, most-searched products, net profit by period). Add preset selectors (e.g., last 7 days/last 30 days/this month) and period grouping selector (e.g., day/week/month) that drive the analytics hooks. Include sensible loading states (Skeleton) and empty/error states (Alert/placeholder text) using existing shadcn/ui components (Card, Skeleton, Alert, Badge). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add new translation keys required by the advanced analytics UI (section titles, selector labels/options, empty/loading/error messages, column labels). Ensure DashboardPage uses only t(...) for any new user-visible strings (no hard-coded strings in new UI).
